messages:
eva (pm): starting a short thread to land fairness + rebalancer behavior when multiple tenants request reserved slabs or launch windows at once. want decision on scoring, acceptance criteria, and M-plan.

ben (infra): +1. This keeps coming up in design reviews. We need a deterministic scoring function so rebalances are explainable to customers.

chloe (eng): propose score = w1*priority + w2*slab_size_pct + w3*time_since_request + w4*recent_waste_penalty. Lower score = higher priority for allocation. That allows business priority to matter but penalizes repeat waste.

samir (sales): clarify "priority" field. Sales asks for ability to set "business_priority" (low/normal/high) at contract time. High should strongly favor allocation but not be absolute. 

olga (sre): perf constraints: rebalancer runs every 30s and must make decisions in <200ms. It should prefer local pool adjustments (thin migrations) vs spinning GPUs. Also need graceful opt-out for customers who don't want auto-rebalance.

eva (pm): rough scoring formula suggestion (weights are tunable):

score = - (10 * business_priority) + (5 * slab_pct) - (0.1 * minutes_waiting) + (20 * wasted_ratio)

where business_priority: high=3, normal=2, low=1; slab_pct: percent headroom requested; wasted_ratio: recent wasted_reserved_tokens / reserved_tokens. Lower score => allocate first.

chloe (eng): example rank table:
- Tenant A (high, slab 15%, waiting 10m, wasted 5%) => score = -(30) + 75 - 1 + 1 = 45
- Tenant B (normal, slab 20%, waiting 2m, wasted 40%) => score = -(20) + 100 - 0.2 + 8 = 87.8
so A favored.

ben (infra): must add caps to avoid a single tenant hogging >X% of pool during constrained state (propose 40% cap). Also band allocations to avoid frequent oscillation (min-commit 5m).

samir (sales): customers will ask for visibility. We should expose a "why-not-allocated" reason with the top-3 contributing factors and the score delta to the tenant. That helps AE conversations.

olga (sre): telemetry required: allocation_events, score_breakdown, reallocations_count, avg_decision_latency, percent_time_pool_constrained. Also an alert when reallocations_count > threshold in 1h.

eva (pm): rollout plan:
M1 (2 sprints): implement scoring service + deterministic simulator (replay historical demand for fairness tuning), API to read current ranking, and basic telemetry. No automatic enforcement in M1 (manual approve).
M2 (3 sprints): enforcement path: allocator applies decisions, adds min-commit and cap, autopromote for scheduled windows, and UI explainers. Start pilot with 2 tenants.
M3 (2 sprints): fairness tuning, waste-reduction heuristics (auto-revoke for stale slabs), and expand pilot to ~8 tenants + billing integration.

chloe (eng): simulator is key. We should run replay for last 6 months of pool traces and compute regret metrics (how often a higher business_priority tenant didn't get allocation). We can tune weights to minimize regret under budget constraints.

ben (infra): edge cases: simultaneous launches where combined slab request > pool capacity. Proposal: partial fill proportional to business_priority-adjusted slab size, with clear customer notice. For example, if A requests 40% and B requests 40% but pool has 50% free, allocate 30% to high-priority, 20% to normal proportional after cap. Need exact tie-break rules.

samir (sales): request: add a "guarantee token" purchase option in contract that bypasses proportional fill once purchased (subject to the same global cap), we can discuss billing separately.

olga (sre): ops acceptance criteria for M2 pilot:
- allocator decision latency < 200ms 95%
- reallocations per tenant <= 4 per 24h during pilot
- no more than 1 outage attributable to rebalancer logic in pilot period
- score explanations emitted in 100% of allocation denials

eva (pm): customer-facing acceptance and launch criteria:
- pilot customers receive allocation_decision_reason in their usage logs for each slab request
- documented runbook and FAQ published
- pilot results show average gold latency degradation <= 8% under contention vs baseline

chloe (eng): dev risks:
- race with admission-controller when releasing reservations (double-counts)
- thrashing if min-commit too short -> implement hysteresis and a 5m cool-down per tenant action

ben (infra): infra tasks: implement leader election for rebalancer, persistent state store for commitments, and an audit log of every allocation decision. Also add a dry-run mode for M1 to see decisions without changing admissions.

samir (sales): i'll draft a short-facing explanation for AEs: "how we prioritize reserved slabs during contention" and list configurable knobs customers can ask for.

eva (pm): OK next steps: Chloe build simulator + scoring service PR; Ben prototype dry-run rebalancer and telemetry; Olga prepare ops runbook skeleton; Samir select 2 pilot candidates; I'll draft acceptance doc and schedule pilot start target 2025-08-04.

oncall-bot: incident-check: no open incidents in pools targeted for pilot.

eva (pm): dropping acceptance checklist here (short):
- scoring service + simulator with historical replay ready
- dry-run rebalancer producing score_breakdown logs for 100% of simulated allocations
- M2 enforcement includes caps, min-commit, and explanation payloads
- pilot signed with 2 tenants for 3 weeks and engineering oncall coverage

chloe (eng): noted, will post initial simulator results in channel before EOD Friday.

eva (pm): thanks folks. Sync next Tue to decide final weight defaults and cap levels. :white_check_mark:
